label: Weddings and events
note: Niche pack for src/niche-pack.ts. Data only: categories, queries, cities, seasonality and the signals that map to the seller's services. Search phrases are web-channel queries (English plus common Hindi and Marathi trade terms) and use {city} and {area} placeholders; the few phrases with no placeholder are deliberately city-free.

categories.label: Wedding planner
categories.buyerReason: Planners subcontract wedding films for their clients, so they buy video again and again.

categories.label: Event company
categories.buyerReason: Event companies stage corporate and social events that need a film or highlight reel every time.

categories.label: Banquet hall
categories.buyerReason: Banquet halls buy event films and venue reels to fill dates and show couples the space.

categories.label: Wedding decorator
categories.buyerReason: Decorators buy films of their setups to win the next client and reuse the footage in bids.

categories.label: Caterer
categories.buyerReason: Caterers buy short food films and event coverage to show menus at tastings and on social.

categories.label: Bridal wear
categories.buyerReason: Bridal wear shops buy lookbook films and reels to sell lehengas and sherwanis online.

categories.label: Makeup artist
categories.buyerReason: Makeup artists buy bridal transformation reels to fill their dates from Instagram.

categories.label: Photographer
categories.buyerReason: Photographers buy video to add candid films and same-day edits to their wedding packages.

categories.label: DJ entertainer
categories.buyerReason: DJs and entertainers buy event films and reels to show a full dance floor to new clients.

categories.label: Florist
categories.buyerReason: Florists buy short films of their installations and bouquets to sell to couples and venues.

categories.label: Invitation designer
categories.buyerReason: Invitation designers buy product films to show card finishes, foil and packaging online.

categories.label: Destination wedding agent
categories.buyerReason: Destination wedding agents buy cinematic location films to sell venues far from home.

categories.label: Jewellery store
categories.buyerReason: Jewellers buy product films and bridal reels to drive online enquiries for wedding sets.

seasonality.note: The main Indian wedding season runs from November to February, with a second wave of bookings in April and May before the monsoon.

signals.meaning: the vendor's profile or site shows photos or text but no video, film, reel or youtube/vimeo link
a video, film, reel or youtube/vimeo link is present
a video or reel posted in the last 30 days
no post in the last 90 days
featured, verified-plus or paid-tier label on the directory
a price or starting price is published

portfolio-no-video.phrase: the profile shows photos or text but no video, film, reel or youtube or vimeo link

has-video-portfolio.phrase: a video, film, reel or youtube or vimeo link is present

social-video-active.phrase: a video or reel was posted in the last 30 days

social-inactive.phrase: no post in the last 90 days

high-review-count.phrase: the business has 50 or more reviews or ratings

premium-listing.phrase: the directory marks this listing as featured, verified-plus or paid-tier

multi-city.phrase: the business serves more than one city

price-band-known.phrase: a price or starting price is published

reasons.portfolio-no-video: the profile shows photos or text but no video, so a wedding or event film would fill that gap
reasons.has-video-portfolio: a video is already on the profile, so a new event film is a lower priority
reasons.social-video-active: a reel was posted in the last 30 days, so event films are already part of the mix
reasons.social-inactive: there has been no post in the last 90 days, so an event film would restart the feed
reasons.high-review-count: the business has 50 or more reviews, so an event film would match its reputation
reasons.premium-listing: the directory marks this listing as featured or paid-tier, so an event film fits its standing
reasons.multi-city: the business serves more than one city, so an event film would work across its markets
reasons.price-band-known: a starting price is published, so an event film with a clear quote is easier to sell
